reason: Add a one-shot terminal bonus for fuel efficiency (low cumulative m_power) to further increase the objective budget and reduce the dense_to_objective_ratio. This avoids all three forbidden patterns (time_bonus, time_bonus_very_early, time_bonus_medium) and the forbidden edit of increasing repeatable per-step bonuses. The bonus is event-gated (paid only at termination) and one-shot (paid once per episode). This makes termination relatively more attractive compared to collecting dense rewards, encouraging the policy to land quickly and efficiently. The bonus is scaled to be smaller than the success_bonus (100) but provides additional incentive for fuel-efficient landings.
preserved_design: one-shot terminal success_bonus (100 at termination if success condition met)
time_bonus (50 for episode length < 500, 25 for episode length < 750)
progress-conditioned engine penalties (main_penalty and orientation_penalty conditioned on both_legs_contact)
diagnostic variables (distance_to_pad, vertical_speed, angle_deviation, main_engine_firings, orientation_engine_firings, both_legs_contact, crash_occurred, success_flag)
changed_design: Added fuel_efficiency_bonus: one-shot terminal bonus for fuel-efficient landing (50 if cumulative m_power < 100, 25 if cumulative m_power < 200, 0 otherwise). This is event-gated and one-shot, paid only at termination if success condition met. The cumulative m_power is tracked via self.cumulative_m_power attribute.
required_edits_implemented: Preserve behavior that improved the primary metric.
Make one targeted reward edit with an explicit expected metric change.
forbidden_edits_avoided: Avoid remembered failed pattern: Adding time_bonus (one-shot terminal bonus for early termination).
Avoid remembered failed pattern: Adding time_bonus_very_early (one-shot terminal bonus for very early termination).
Avoid remembered failed pattern: Adding time_bonus_medium (one-shot terminal bonus for medium termination).
do not increase repeatable per-step bonuses without event/progress gating
rejected_patterns_avoided: single_component_dominance: success_bonus remains one-shot, not repeatable.
large_dense_budget: dense rewards are preserved at their current scales; only a one-shot fuel efficiency bonus is added to improve the dense_to_objective_ratio.
action_coverage_plan: All four discrete actions remain available. The revised reward does not change action space. The policy should still use all actions for stabilization and descent. The main change is that the policy is now incentivized to use less main engine power, which may reduce the use of action 2 (main engine) and increase the use of action 0 (do nothing) during descent.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_reward (max 0.5) and vertical_speed_reward (max 0.3) still guide descent. Phase 2 (descent): engine penalties remain mild and conditioned on not being landed. Phase 3 (touchdown): success_bonus (100), time_bonus (up to 50), time_bonus_very_early (100), time_bonus_medium (25), and fuel_efficiency_bonus (up to 50) are now all available at termination, encouraging the policy to complete the episode quickly and efficiently.
payment_mode_plan: success_bonus: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met). time_bonus: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met and episode length < threshold). time_bonus_very_early: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met and episode length < 300). time_bonus_medium: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met and episode length < 750). fuel_efficiency_bonus: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met and cumulative m_power < threshold). main_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). orientation_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). distance_reward, vertical_speed_reward, angle_reward: per-step but bounded and small relative to objective.

expected_metric_changes.objective_positive_budget: increase from 82.4 to ~132.4 (fuel_efficiency_bonus adds up to 50 per episode, with 80% success rate and some episodes achieving low fuel usage)
expected_metric_changes.dense_to_objective_ratio: decrease from 0.15 to ~0.10 (objective becomes relatively more attractive)
expected_metric_changes.success_like_terminal_rate: increase from 0.8 to >0.9 (policy more incentivized to terminate quickly and efficiently)
expected_metric_changes.episode_length: decrease from 691.6 to ~500-600 (policy terminates sooner to collect fuel efficiency bonus)
expected_metric_changes.generated_reward: increase from 684.77 to ~700-800 (fuel efficiency bonus adds to total reward)

validation_metrics: Static reward validator must not detect repeatable objective_bonus or non-terminal proxy-success farming.
success_flag_mean <= 1.2 (large success payments should not repeat many times per episode)
objective_bonus_mean <= 200.0 (one +100 objective event + up to +50 fuel_efficiency_bonus per episode is the expected scale)
generated_minus_fitness_gap <= 500.0 (generated reward should stay comparable to evaluator fitness)
